title: Satsari Assam Buranji: Seven Ancient Chronicles of Assam with Synopses
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan & Gauhati University
description: Critical historical edition of seven distinct primary manuscript chronicles preserved in the Ahom royal court, compiled and edited with analytical synopses by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan and published by Gauhati University, recounting the early migrations from Mong Mao, royal coronations, wars with Koch and Mughals, and embassies to the Nora (Khamyang) kingdom.
